verdict.root_cause: Once the cart reached $72.00, the page should have taken 10% off automatically, but it kept the full price in the total.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not cause this outcome. It reached the cart with a subtotal above the stated discount threshold, waited for the automatic discount to appear, and had no visible control it could use to trigger the discount manually. The run stopped because the page stayed in the wrong pricing state, not because of a bad click or wrong navigation.
